decls.name: Prop22NormOneElements

paper_span.quote: Then there is a set \(U\subset Q^{-2}\mathcal O_K\) such that every \(u\in U\) satisfies \(N_{K/L}(u)=1\)

decls.rationale: Proposition 2.2 in full: from an admissible datum with \(h(K) \le H^f\) it produces the set \(U \subset Q^{-2}\mathcal{O}_K\) of relative-norm-one elements, all of whose complex embeddings have modulus 1, with \(|U| \ge \exp\{(t\log 2 - \log H)f\}\) — the three conclusions of the Lean statement.
